Small fixup on tools/needs-you-triage.mjs. Logging-only; change nothing else.

1. In refreshTriageLock's catch and releaseTriageLock's catch: a SyntaxError is an EXPECTED race (writeLockExclusive opens with 'wx' then writes, and refresh rewrites non-atomically, so another process can read '' or partial JSON). Make SyntaxError silent just like ENOENT: remove the 'corrupt lock file' branches so these catches log only when `error?.code !== 'ENOENT' && !(error instanceof SyntaxError)`.

2. refreshTriageLock is called once per item inside runNeedsYouTriagePass, so a persistent error (EACCES/EISDIR) would print once per item. Add a module-level `const loggedRefreshCodes = new Set();` and in refreshTriageLock's catch only console.error when the error's code (use `error?.code ?? error?.name ?? 'unknown'`) is not already in the set, then add it.

3. In readLockPayload, rename the inner unlink catch binding from `error` to `unlinkError` (it shadows the outer `error`), updating its uses inside that inner catch only.

Keep all existing comments and the log prefixes. Do not touch any other catch. No unused bindings, no `void error`. Then run: node --import ./tests/_isolate-config.mjs --test tests/needs-you-triage.test.mjs and confirm green.
